notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
🌟 New Features
English Voice Audio for Dialogues: Experience a new level of immersion with fully integrated English voiceovers for key dialogues, adding depth to the storytelling and overall gameplay.

🌍 Expanded Localization
We've added support for 16 new languages to make the game more accessible and enjoyable for a global audience:

Arabic, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.
Whether you're solving puzzles, exploring, or engaging with the story, you can now enjoy the game in your preferred language!

🎮 Gameplay & UI Enhancements
Improved Gameplay UI & Menu UI: We’ve polished the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience. Menus and gameplay elements are now more visually appealing and easier to navigate.

📷 Camera Improvements
Reduced Wall-Crossing: Adjustments to camera mechanics prevent it from unintentionally crossing through walls, helping you stay fully immersed in the game world.
Enhanced Camera Transitions: Transitions between various objects and points of interest are now smoother, creating a more seamless visual experience.

🔧 Additional Updates
Various Small Changes: This update also includes multiple minor tweaks and improvements to enhance stability, visuals, and overall gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update[/h1]
The update brings some bug fixes, changes and gameplay improvements.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Exciting New Puzzles[/h3]
A variety of fresh and intriguing puzzles have been introduced to challenge players. These puzzles incorporate new elements such as interactive environments, multi-step problem-solving, and hidden object searches. Players will need to use their wits and observational skills to overcome these new obstacles.

[h3]Enhanced Guidance Dialogues[/h3]
To improve player experience and provide better in-game guidance, the dialogues have been enriched with more hints and narrative context. These dialogues will subtly direct players without giving away solutions, maintaining the game's mystery and challenge.

[h3]Gamepad Support[/h3]
Gamepad controls are now supported, offering a more immersive and intuitive gameplay experience. Players can enjoy smoother navigation and interaction using their preferred game controllers..

[h3]Improved Player Movement[/h3]
Player movement has been refined for a more responsive and fluid experience. This includes smoother transitions, better handling, and more realistic animations, enhancing overall gameplay satisfaction.

[h3]Enhanced Game Story[/h3]
The game story has been expanded and enriched with deeper lore, more engaging characters, and intricate plot twists. This will provide players with a more captivating and immersive narrative experience.

[h3]Additional Exciting Features[/h3]
A host of new features have been added to enhance the gaming experience, including improved graphics, new character abilities, and more diverse environments. These additions aim to make the adventure even more thrilling and visually stunning.
